# 📥 ISSUE FORMS

<a name="top"></a>

**The one form a move arrives on, and the chooser that offers it.**

_A move link opens it, ready to submit._

</div>

---

## 💡 What This Folder Is For

Every move on the profile is a link that opens an issue here on the move form,
its title already written. The form explains how to read that title, asks for
one ticked box, agreeing to the games' rules and to how they show a player,
and labels the issue `move`.

The chooser offers that form, a way back to the profile and the private
security channel, and nothing else: blank issues are switched off, and because
this folder has files of its own, the account's issue forms are not inherited
here.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Never give this README YAML front matter.** GitHub lists a Markdown file in
> this folder as an issue template only when it opens with front matter naming
> it. This one opens with an HTML comment instead, which is why the chooser
> never shows it.
